summary: This directory manages the identification, discovery, and listing of TypeScript projects within a workspace. It provides the necessary infrastructure to locate and validate configuration files to support project-level analysis and tooling operations.
responsibilities: Discover TypeScript projects within a directory structure
List and validate active project configurations
Provide project-level metadata for downstream tools
relationships: The discovery process identifies valid TypeScript projects by locating specific configuration files within the workspace.
Project metadata is gathered during the listing process to inform other system components about available build targets.
